scope: One bounded price-path diagnostic from 31 frozen same-event same-I-buy/CP-state failure/winner pairs; outcome-conditioned already seen cases, not prediction or OOS. No new ranking, gate, quantity, exit, cooldown, parameter scan, account or economic rerun.
hypothesis: At comparable original PVR, mu, CP state, net progress and total variation, time spent below the contemporaneous within-window close peak might describe persistence of unrecovered pullbacks beyond amplitude efficiency. It is not presumed predictive.
formula: n=21 returns, 22 immediate common sessions, x_j=log(native close), j=0..21. V=sum_{j=1..21}|x_j-x_{j-1}|; d_j=max_{0<=k<=j}x_k-x_j; A=mean_{j=1..21}d_j. Single candidate Q=1-A/V. V=0 => UNKNOWN, not epsilon. Old efficiency ER=(x_21-x_0)/V is control only; no combination score. Q in [0,1].
clock: t-close only, exact 22 common consecutive sessions; observed, positive eligible rawOHLC, no source invalid/synthetic, same source kind/path/segment/factor. Native close cross-check. No future or next-open inputs. Rolling window resets at its left boundary, not at I/CP; edge-roll sensitivity must be disclosed.
prior_work: ER10/63; signed Qclose14; Qrange14/F; PVR weighted eta; FIP; CE; latest-leg ordered pullback J; lifecycle H/h; CP-anchor current/max drawdown; pre-high distance; CUSUM.
